supporting_pages.title: Create a Dataflow pipeline using Python \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Run the pipeline: python -m apache beam.examples.wordcount \ --region DATAFLOW REGION \ --input gs://dataflow-samples/shakespeare/kinglear.txt \ --output gs:// BUCKET NAME /results/outputs \ --runner DataflowRunner \ --project PROJECT ID \ --temp location gs:// BUCKET NAME /tmp/ Replace the following: DATAFLOW REGION : the region where you want to deploy the Dataflow job—for example, europe-west1 The --region flag overrides the default region that is set in the metadata server, your local client, or environment variables.
Create a Dataflow pipeline using Python This document shows you how to use the Apache Beam SDK for Python to build a program that defines a pipeline.
Set up your environment Dataflow no longer supports pipelines using Python 2.
